column1: # Two independent blockers: the ESP panicked in the profile_executor task, and
# separately NO HEAT ever reached the kiln -- duty ran to saturation with the
# zone temperatures flat at ambient the entire time. NO dwell was reached, so
# there is no hold point here and nothing in this file bears on the coupling
# matrix. It is kept only as the record of the no-heat symptom.
# Ambient at run start: enclosure 32.03 C; zones 31.78 / 31.69 / 31.62 C.
# Ambient at run end:   enclosure 32.28 C; zones 32.00 / 32.00 / 31.91 C.
# ff_hold_infeasible: never, on any zone, in any sample.
# Raw 5 s capture (gitignored, local only, as with every logs/coupling/*.jsonl):
# LAST SAMPLE ABOVE IS 10:38:13. The board panicked and rebooted moments later;
# the 5 s poll saw two HTTP timeouts at 10:38:26/10:38:34 and then state=idle
# with last_run.present=false -- a reboot, not a stop.
# z2 held duty 1.000 for the final ~90 s with zero measurable temperature rise.
